name: Port Scanning
description: Ability to perform comprehensive port scanning against target hosts and networks using tools such as Nmap, Masscan, and Unicornscan. Covers TCP/UDP scanning techniques, scan timing and evasion, output interpretation, and the ability to scope scans appropriately for the engagement context.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to port scanning tools or concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands TCP/UDP port concepts and the purpose of port scanning in engagements
evidence: Can explain the difference between TCP and UDP scanning
Understands the three-way handshake and how SYN scanning works
Can describe common port ranges and well-known service ports

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs basic port scans under supervision and interprets results with guidance
evidence: Executes Nmap SYN and TCP connect scans on lab targets
Interprets Nmap output to identify open, closed, and filtered ports
Documents scan results in engagement notes under review
Follows lab rules of engagement for scan scope and timing

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and executes scanning campaigns appropriate to engagement scope
evidence: Selects appropriate scan types and timing profiles for the engagement context
Performs comprehensive TCP and UDP scans across large network ranges
Uses Nmap scripting engine (NSE) for targeted service detection
Integrates scan results into engagement workflow and reporting

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex scanning scenarios; optimizes scan performance; mentors junior staff
evidence: Develops custom Nmap NSE scripts for specialized reconnaissance
Optimizes scan parameters for speed and stealth in constrained environments
Combines multiple scanning tools (Nmap, Masscan, Unicornscan) for comprehensive coverage
Reviews and mentors junior staff on scan methodology and interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines scanning methodology for the lab; develops advanced evasion and detection techniques
evidence: Authored the lab's port scanning methodology and standard operating procedures
Develops novel scan techniques that evade common IDS/IPS detection
Published research on scanning techniques or tool improvements
Trains teams on advanced scanning strategy and tool usage

assessment_methods.description: Scan a lab network segment and produce a complete host and service inventory within a time constraint
Review scan logs and documentation from a recent engagement for completeness and appropriate technique selection
